name: Business Owner Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign business owner applies with a residence certificate (issued by local administrative/police authority), a 3-month entry visa, the company's taxpayer card, and a company profile. Initial approval grants a temporary resident card; the (renewable) permanent-track permit follows roughly 3 months later, valid 2 years. No minimum capital or investment threshold was found in the sources reached -- the requirement appears to rest on operating a genuinely registered Cameroonian business rather than a quantified capital bar.
requirements.fix_path: Register a business in Cameroon with a taxpayer card, obtain a residence certificate and 3-month entry visa, then apply for the business-owner residence card.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 6 years uninterrupted residence for permanent-resident card eligibility

sources.title: Cameroon Visa Info -- business-owner residence-card process, document requirements, no stated capital threshold
